title: Specialized Practicum in Child and Youth Care
description: In consultation with a faculty adviser, students select a special setting for advanced work and training. In some settings, this may take the form of a clinical internship. Students work under supervision and consult regularly with both the practicum supervisor and faculty course instructor. Students may be required to complete a specialized theory or intervention course in their area of focus prior to undertaking the specialized practicum. Students are required to complete a minimum of 200 hours.
